svg.aria-label: Left: the standard deviation of pre-activations through 50 ReLU layers, on a log scale: with small weights it collapses at once, with Xavier initialisation it halves in variance each layer, with He initialisation it stays constant. Right: training loss of a 20-layer network: the first two initialisations never train, He initialisation and Xavier with layer normalisation both reach zero loss
svg.text: Xavier: halves the variance per layer
training a 20-layer network on the spirals
